# mtncloud_datastore (Data Source)

Looks up one datastore by ID or by name, including one made in the console. Datastores hold volumes. To list where one project can store volumes, use `mtncloud_datastores`. A name must match exactly one datastore.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_datastore" "example" {
  name = "ceph-ssd"
}

output "datastore_free_space" {
  value = data.mtncloud_datastore.example.free_space
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the datastore. Give this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the datastore, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether it is active.
- `free_space` (Number) Free space in bytes, or 0 when unknown.
- `online` (Boolean) Whether it is online.
- `status` (String) Status.
- `storage_size` (Number) Size in bytes, or 0 when unknown.
- `type` (String) Datastore type.
- `visibility` (String) `private` or `public`.
